title: Greeting Bot
brief: Build a friendly robot that knows your name and your age, and says hello! You'll use variables and the print spell — everything you learned in Module 1.
steps: Make a variable called name and put your name inside it (in quotes).
Make a variable called age and put your age inside it (a number).
Use print() to say hello using your name.
Use print() to say how old you are using your age.
starterCode:
# Your Greeting Bot
name = ""

print("Hello, my name is " + name)
print("I am", age, "years old")
successMessage: Your Greeting Bot is alive! 🤖 You combined variables and print like a real coder.
